caption: The drawing depicts a wooden piece of furniture, specifically a small table with four tapered, fluted legs. The tabletop features a rounded and tiered backboard with three curves, each rising to a different height, while the front edge of the tabletop is gently curved. The table’s front apron includes a decorative motif in its central panel. The wood is depicted in various shades of brown, with visible grain, giving a realistic texture to the surface of the table. The drawing uses clean lines and subtle shading to suggest depth and three-dimensionality, and the table occupies the central portion of the plain, light beige background. There is a thin, rectangular outline framing the drawing, and a signature appears in the bottom left corner.
title: Card Table
